verdict: Organic presence is holding; GBP visibility drop is being addressed now.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, inbound activity ran entirely through Google Business Profile — paid channels have been inactive for the full 28-day window. Combined, your three locations generated 402 GBP actions, including 26 calls, 262 direction requests, and 114 website clicks, which reflects genuine local search demand. However, two of the three locations recorded zero GBP actions over the final three days of the period (Aug 23–25), and search click volume also declined week-over-week at those locations — the root cause is being investigated and a fix has been submitted for completion by Aug 31. CRM setup milestones from July remain open, and closing those is the prerequisite for paid campaigns going live; that reconciliation work is on track for the Aug 31 milestone.

watch_item.issue: GBP visibility dropped to zero actions for three consecutive days at two locations, with search clicks also declining — pointing to an organic search visibility issue.
